order.title: File order
order.$comment: File IDs in the order to merge. The core passes inputs to the worker in this order, so the adapter itself never sees file IDs.

metadataFrom.title: Document properties from
metadataFrom.description: Which file's title, author and other properties the result keeps: 0 is the first file in the order below, 1 the second, and -1 keeps none.

fileTitles.$comment: Bookmark title for each input, in merge order. Filled in by the core from the file names; not shown in the form.
